title: Agents Feedback Record
description: A repository-local feedback record that captures a sanitized agent observation and its lifecycle state.

schema_version.description: Record schema identifier. Use feedback-record.v1 for v1 records.

id.description: Stable record identifier and filename prefix using UTC date, time, and a short slug.

title.description: Short human-readable record title for list displays.

status.description: Lifecycle state. This value must match the folder containing the record.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp for when the record was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp for the most recent meaningful record update.

completed_at.description: UTC completion timestamp. Set only when status is completed; otherwise use null.

area.description: Repository area affected by the observation, such as docs, tests, setup, tooling, or workflow.

kind.description: Category of feedback so future agents can scan related records.

severity.description: Expected impact on future agent work if the observation is not addressed.

summary.description: One-sentence scan line describing the observation.

description.description: Full context future agents need to understand the observation without private logs or secrets.

evidence.description: Sanitized evidence summary. Summarize relevant symptoms instead of pasting raw logs or private content.

impact.description: Explanation of how the observation affects future agent efficiency, safety, verification, or setup.

suggested_actions.description: One or more possible actions that could address the observation before a decision is selected.

id.description: Stable suggested action identifier within this record, such as action-1.

rationale.description: Why this action may address the feedback.

effort.description: Estimated implementation effort for this action.

risk.description: Estimated risk or blast radius for this action.

decision.description: Current outcome decision for the record.

related_files.description: Repository-relative files that contain durable changes, evidence, or canonical follow-up context.

plan.description: Selected action plan and progress tracker, or null before planning is useful.

sanitized.description: True only after reviewing the record for restricted content.

redaction_notes.description: Short note describing any redaction performed; leave empty when no redaction was needed.
